    FileHandler
    FileHandler - Handles all CSV file input/output operations RESPONSIBILITIES: - Read CSV files and return data as List<String[]> - Write data (List<String[]>) back to CSV files OOP & SOLID PRINCIPLES: - SINGLE RESPONSIBILITY: Handles only file reading/writing - OPEN/CLOSED: Easily extendable for other file formats - ENCAPSULATION: File operations are hidden from other components
